tweaks.name: Ask about audience and goal first
Color is never the only signal
tweaks.source_quote: Color is not used as the only visual means of conveying information

tweaks.name: Text resizes to 200% intact
tweaks.source_quote: text can be resized without assistive technology up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality

tweaks.name: Structure is in the markup
tweaks.source_quote: Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined

tweaks.name: Text contrast 7:1 (AAA)
tweaks.source_quote: contrast ratio of at least 7:1

tweaks.name: Reading order matches meaning
tweaks.source_quote: a correct reading sequence can be programmatically determined

tweaks.name: Every field has a label
tweaks.source_quote: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input

tweaks.name: Errors named in text
tweaks.source_quote: the item that is in error is identified and the error is described to the user in text

tweaks.name: Errors suggest a fix
tweaks.source_quote: suggestions for correction are known, then the suggestions are provided to the user

tweaks.name: Headings describe their section
tweaks.source_quote: Headings and labels describe topic or purpose

tweaks.name: Link text says where it goes
tweaks.source_quote: The purpose of each link can be determined from the link text alone

tweaks.name: Images have text alternatives
tweaks.source_quote: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative

tweaks.name: Focus never hidden by overlays
tweaks.source_quote: the component is not entirely hidden due to author-created content

tweaks.name: Survives user text spacing
tweaks.source_quote: Line height (line spacing) to at least 1.5 times the font size

tweaks.name: Dragging has a click alternative
tweaks.source_quote: All functionality that uses a dragging movement for operation can be achieved by a single pointer without dragging

tweaks.name: Login without memory puzzles
tweaks.source_quote: A cognitive function test (such as remembering a password or solving a puzzle) is not required for any step in an authentication process

tweaks.name: Don't ask twice for the same data
tweaks.source_quote: Information previously entered by or provided to the user that is required to be entered again

tweaks.name: UI parts contrast 3:1
tweaks.source_quote: have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent color

tweaks.name: Moving content can be paused
tweaks.source_quote: there is a mechanism for the user to pause, stop, or hide it

tweaks.name: Clear errors once fixed
tweaks.source_quote: we should remove the error message the moment the input becomes valid

tweaks.name: Validate on submit, not keystroke
tweaks.source_quote: validate these input fields on submit only to avoid premature errors
